description: Le marché du haut et très haut débit fixe (déploiements) à l'échelle des immeubles de Troyes Champagne Métropole is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Troyes Champagne Métropole. Description Cartefibre.arcep.fr is Arcep's mapping tool, which aims to improve information for the general public and professionals on fibre-optic network deployments to the subscriber. Established at both the municipal and technical (generally sub-municipal) grids, it is part of the high-speed and very high-speed fixed broadband observatory set up by the Authority. Coverage: Troyes Champagne Métropole. The portal shows the English title as "The fixed broadband and very high-speed market (deployments) at the scale of the buildings of Troyes Champagne Métropole" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Troyes Champagne Métropole. Its keywords include tres-haut-debit, troyes-champagne-metropole, haut-debit. The listing shows 4 download or service links in PDF, XLSX, GPKG, CSV. The listing shows 2024-08-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
